purpose: Teach: 符号/執拗/再三/先々/最長/怠慢/随所/つくろ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、データの符号化ルールを覚えろ
lines.en: Ren. Learn the data encoding rules.
lines.style: Clear, measured authority. Opening address is direct but not sharp. Instruction lands with quiet conviction. No rush — the expectation is already set.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。執拗な質問にも丁寧に答えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll answer even the most persistent questions carefully.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine, not performative. Slight hesitation before the commitment — he's thinking through what he's promising. Steady eye contact. Earnest without being strained.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、再三の実験で確証を得ろ
lines.en: Ren. Get confirmation through repeated experiments.
lines.style: Same measured tone. Slightly more weight on 「確証」— it's the key word. Not lecturing, instructing. The pause after his name signals: this is important.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先々の研究計画も視野に入れます
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep future research plans in view too.
lines.style: Quiet determination. He's already thinking ahead — the words come slightly faster, like he's caught himself planning. Eager but held back by respect for the moment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、最長の研究期間を見据えろ
lines.en: Ren. Keep the long research timeline in sight.
lines.style: Firmer now. Weight on 「最長」— this is about patience and perspective. A small pause before speaking, like settling into the important part of the conversation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究に怠慢があってはなりません
lines.en: Yes. The research can't afford to be careless.
lines.style: Formal politeness with real anxiety underneath. He's absorbed the weight of the instruction. Words come carefully, each one deliberate. Almost holding his breath slightly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の随所に独自性を出せ
lines.en: Ren. Put originality throughout the paper.
lines.style: Direct instruction with a note of invitation beneath it. Not demanding, but expecting. A slight lean forward in the voice — he believes Ren can do this.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先行研究をつくろう新仮説を立てます
lines.en: Yes. I'll build on prior research and form new hypotheses.
lines.style: Words come with focus and acceptance. He understands the full scope now. Small, grounded breath at the end — he's centered. Commitment has weight to it.
